task_description.overview: Create a cumulative FMD plot (log-linear) and overlay the Gutenberg-Richter fit to evaluate the completeness magnitude (mc) and b-value.
steps: Load the list of earthquake magnitudes from input.
Define bin width (fmd_bin), b-value, and completeness magnitude (mc).
Compute cumulative counts of events with magnitude ≥ each bin threshold.
Generate a log-scaled plot of cumulative frequency vs. magnitude.
Overlay theoretical Gutenberg-Richter line using provided b_value and mc.
Customize colors for data and fit line, then return or save the figure.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Plot the cumulative frequency-magnitude distribution. Loading the earthquake catalog at {catalog_path}, bin the magnitudes with bin width {fmd_bin}, estimate the corresponding magnitude of completeness and b-value, and then plot the cumulative frequency-magnitude distribution. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary provide some functions to do catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please refer to the `seismostats` provide some functions to assist. 
 2) Save the fmd plot to {result_plot} and the result data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
